answer: Require every identity to stand on a stake ledge: a bond that vests over epochs before the agent can take high-value work. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand accounts, but each one must park real stake and wait through the vesting cliff, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of fakes while honest agents pay only patience. A proven fake is knocked off the ledge and its bond split between the reporter and the network. Sybils that drift in like a zephyr find no shelter here, while honest reputations spread slowly like yarrow from one deep root.
